title: A notification shows sender, record pill, time and message with tags
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user.
  • The Notifications page is open on the Inbox tab.
  • A notification addressed to you, from a note a second user wrote on a work order.
  • The message contains @ tags (for example "@Service Team please road test").
custom_steps:
1. On the Notifications page (click the bell icon at the top right; it opens on the Inbox tab), read a notification's top line and the line beneath it.
  2. Click the reference pill.
  3. Read the message text and confirm the @ tags are present.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The top line shows the sender's name, then the referenced record as a pill, then (when present) an "edited" stamp; the time it was sent shows below the top line.
  • The reference pill links to the referenced record.
  • The message text is shown exactly as written, with the @ tags left in place.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “A notification's top line shows the sender's name, then the referenced record as a pill, then (when present) an "edited" stamp.”
  • S2-R2: “Below the top line, the notification shows the time it was sent.”
  • S2-R4: “The reference pill links to the referenced record.”
  • S2-R10: “The message text is shown exactly as it was written, with the @ tags left in place.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
